description: Plan F advance — evaluates the proton Habiro tr_M polynomial (from habiro-coefficients-atomic.witness.json) at q_0 to 50 dps, demonstrating the first end-to-end mpmath datapoint for the categorical mass derivation. NOTE: this is Term 1 of the six-term unified mass formula only; comparing to m_p_pred from mass-table-best is not apples-to-apples.

comparison_for_reference_only.note: term_1_only_b_pred_mev_50dps captures only Term 1 of the six-term mass formula; not directly comparable to m_p_pred which sums all six terms.
